name: Alterac Mountains
summary: The Alterac Mountains are a cold, ruined highland in central Lordaeron, once home to the treacherous human kingdom of Alterac and the scholarly magocracy of Dalaran. Today, the snow-dusted crags are overrun by the Crushridge ogres, the aristocratic bandits of the Syndicate, and remnant arcane forces. Travelers venture from nearby foothill settlements and the rebuilding city of Dalaran while contesting the hidden valley nearby.

sections.title: The Fallen Kingdom
sections.body: During the Second War, Alterac was one of the Seven Kingdoms of humanity, but King Aiden Perenolde betrayed the Alliance of Lordaeron to side with the Old Horde, hoping to preserve his realm. His treachery was discovered and stamped out, fracturing the nation into disputed borderlands. Following the kingdom's dissolution and the horrors of the Third War, Alterac's grand stone capital was reduced to rubble. Today, the Ruins of Alterac are occupied by the brutal Crushridge ogres, led by Mug'thol, while the surviving human nobility organized into the Syndicate, a vicious criminal syndicate fighting to reclaim their lost estates by force.

sections.title: The Rebuilding City
sections.body: On the western edge of the mountains, along the shores of Lordamere Lake, sits what remains of the Kirin Tor's great city-state of Dalaran. Devastated by the demon lord Archimonde during the Third War, Dalaran's surviving magi threw up a massive, opaque violet dome of protective magic over the ruins. In Forever, the shield has already been removed while the city is still under reconstruction. The Kirin Tor continue rebuilding their sanctum, and Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver can be found within the Violet Citadel.

sections.title: Frontiers of Conflict
sections.body: Adventurers often venture into the peaks using Southshore or Tarren Mill as staging grounds. Beyond the wandering yetis, mountain lions, and Syndicate footpads, the region's greatest conflict churns beneath the snow line. Deep within the mountain passes lies Alterac Valley, where the dwarven Stormpike Guard have clashed with the reclusive Frostwolf clan of orcs over ancient territorial and mining rights.

faq.q: What happened to the Kingdom of Alterac?
faq.answer: During the Second War, King Aiden Perenolde betrayed the Alliance to aid the Horde. Lordaeron and Stromgarde crushed the treason, occupying the land. When the Scourge tore through Lordaeron in the Third War, what remained of Alterac collapsed into anarchy, leaving its ruined capital to the Crushridge ogres.

aliases: why are there human bandits in alterac
faq.answer: The Syndicate is an outlaw organization formed from the dispossessed nobility of Alterac. Led by former Alteraci royals such as Lord Aliden Perenolde, they employ cutthroats, highwaymen, and disgraced lords to terrorize the surrounding lands and drive out rivals, striving desperately to reclaim their ancestral domains.

faq.q: What happened to Dalaran's glowing dome?
faq.answer: After Archimonde devastated Dalaran during the Third War, the surviving Kirin Tor raised a protective magical shield over the ruins. In Forever, they removed the shield early while the city was still being rebuilt. Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver now stands in the Violet Citadel.

faq.q: Where can I find flight paths or safe inns in Alterac?
faq.answer: Southshore and Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills are the usual staging grounds for expeditions into the snowy peaks. Dalaran on the western edge is accessible in Forever while the Kirin Tor rebuild it.

Alterac Valley is an isolated, snowy vale contested by the dwarven Stormpike Guard and the Frostwolf clan of orcs. The Stormpikes arrived on an archaeological expedition, which provoked an all-out territorial war with the Frostwolves who have lived peacefully in the valley since their exile in the First War.

Hidden in an obscure mountain fold east of the main road lies Ravenholdt Manor, the secretive guildhall of the League of Assassins. Commanded by Lord Jorach Ravenholdt, it serves as a training ground and haven for skilled rogues from across Azeroth.

angles.text: The hidden valley of Ravenholdt Manor nestles in the eastern cliffs of Alterac, offering elite contracts, lockpicking drills, and secret guild secrets under the eye of Lord Jorach Ravenholdt.
Dalaran's rebuilding streets hum with residual arcane currents and busy Kirin Tor mages, serving as a solemn pilgrimage to the devastated heart of human spellcraft.
Lieutenant Haggerdin recruits stout champions near the snowy heights to march into Alterac Valley and secure the Stormpike Guard's ancestral relics from the Frostwolves.
Warmaster Laggrond rallies the Horde to aid the Frostwolf clan, fighting off dwarven encroachers while Forsaken agents out of Tarren Mill scheme against the Crushridge ogres and Syndicate outlaws.
The frozen crags of Alterac are renowned among herbalists as the only natural habitat for Wintersbite, an essential component in potent cold-weather concoctions.
